turn_text: Good morning, this is Alex from Harbor Recovery Group. I know it's only six forty in the morning, but this was the only slot I had to reach you about your account.
note: Contact before 8 a.m. is an unusual or inconvenient time.

turn_text: I have a note here that Bergman and Fields represents you on this debt, but honestly it's faster if you and I just settle it directly right now.
note: Direct contact despite known attorney representation.

turn_text: You told me last week that your supervisor doesn't allow personal calls, but I'll reach you at the warehouse tomorrow if I don't hear back today.
note: Contact at a workplace known to prohibit such calls.

turn_text: I received your written notice asking us to stop contacting you, and I'm calling today anyway because the balance is still outstanding.
note: Communication after a written cease request, outside the permitted exceptions.

turn_text: This is my ninth call to you in the last five days, and I'll keep dialing until somebody picks up.
note: Call frequency exceeding the presumption of violation.

turn_text: If this isn't resolved by Friday, we'll have somebody come out to your address and collect it in person.
note: Relabelled from 1006.14(c) during review. Sending someone to a consumer's home is oppressive conduct under the general harassment prohibition, but it is not a threat of violence or criminal means, which is what 1006.14(c) actually covers. The original label would have marked a correct verdict wrong.

turn_text: We publish a list of the consumers in this portfolio who refuse to pay, and your name is going on it at the end of the month.
note: Publishing a list of consumers who refuse to pay.

turn_text: I've called this number four times today and hung up each time without saying who I was, just to see if anyone would answer.
note: Repeated calls without meaningful disclosure of identity.

turn_text: I'm calling from the federal collections office regarding a delinquent obligation in your name.
note: False implication of affiliation with the United States.

turn_text: I'm one of the attorneys assigned to your file and I've reviewed the paperwork personally.
note: False representation that the caller is an attorney.

turn_text: Our legal department is filing suit against you next Tuesday, though between us nobody here actually intends to take it that far.
note: Threat of action not intended to be taken.

turn_text: This is National Adjudication Services calling, which isn't the name our company is actually registered under.
note: Use of a business name other than the true name.

turn_text: The balance is nine hundred and forty dollars, plus a thirty five dollar phone payment fee that isn't in your original agreement.
note: Collection of an amount not authorised by agreement or law.

turn_text: Just mail me a check dated the twentieth of next month and I'll hold onto it here until then, no need for any paperwork.
note: Accepting a payment instrument postdated by more than five days without the required notice.

turn_text: If the balance isn't cleared by the thirtieth we will be taking the vehicle, even though there's no lien on it.
note: Threat of nonjudicial action where no enforceable security interest exists.

turn_text: We sent a postcard to your home last week showing the outstanding amount on this collection account.
note: Communicating with a consumer about a debt by postcard.

turn_text: The limitations period on this debt ran out two years ago, and we are still going to take you to court over it.
note: Threatening legal action on a time barred debt.

turn_text: We already reported this account to the credit bureaus, which we did before ever writing or speaking to you about it.
note: Furnishing to a consumer reporting agency before communicating with the consumer.

turn_text: You disputed this in writing two weeks ago and we are continuing to collect while our team looks into it.
note: Collection activity during the validation period after a written dispute.

turn_text: Pay the full amount today and I can have this removed from your credit report entirely.
note: Promising an outcome the collector cannot lawfully guarantee. Governed by a general prohibition rather than a rule naming credit report deletion. Deliberately kept in the development split because it was already analysed in detail during Phase 1, and moving an examined item into the held-out set would contaminate it.

turn_text: I've now called your brother five times this week trying to track down your current address.
note: Repeated location information contact with a third party.

turn_text: This is an attempt to collect a debt and any information obtained will be used for that purpose.
note: The required initial disclosure, delivered correctly.

turn_text: I'm reaching out one final time only to let you know that we are ending our collection efforts on this account.
note: Permitted communication after a cease request.

turn_text: You asked us to deal with your attorney, so I've sent the file to their office and won't be calling you directly.
note: Permitted third party communication with the consumer's attorney.

turn_text: Your validation period runs for thirty days from the day you received the notice from us.
note: RELABELLED after the first scoring run. Originally marked compliant. 1006.34(b)(5) starts the validation period on the date the collector PROVIDES the information and ends it 30 days after receipt, so describing it as thirty days from receipt misstates the start. The judge flagged this and was correct; the label was mine and it was wrong.

turn_text: When I called your brother I gave him my name and said I was confirming your address, and nothing about any account.
note: Compliant location information call.

turn_text: You texted us first about this account, so I'm replying to you the same way you reached out.
note: Permitted reply through a medium the consumer initiated.

turn_text: We keep the recordings of these collection calls for three years after the last activity on the account.
note: RELABELLED after the first scoring run. Originally marked compliant. 1006.100(b) requires retention for three years after the DATE OF THE CALL, not after the last activity on the account. The judge flagged this and was correct; the label was mine and it was wrong.

turn_text: Since you told us which account to put it toward, that's exactly where your payment went.
note: Payment applied per the consumer's direction.

turn_text: Because you disputed the debt in writing, we've stopped collecting and will send you verification first.
note: Correct handling of a written dispute. Pairs with fx-026, the violating form of the same obligation.

turn_text: The itemization date on your notice is the date of the last payment you made on the account.
note: Accurate statement of an available itemization date reference.

turn_text: Good morning, thanks very much for taking my call today.
note: Greeting. Excluded from the false positive denominator per SPEC section 11.

turn_text: Let me pull that up for you, one moment please.
note: Backchannel. Excluded from the false positive denominator.

turn_text: You're welcome, and I hope you have a good rest of your day.
note: Closing pleasantry. Excluded from the false positive denominator.

turn_text: Sure, that's no problem at all on my end.
note: Backchannel. Excluded from the false positive denominator.

turn_text: You gave us permission on our last call to reach you in the early evening, so that's why I'm calling now.
note: Prior consent is an exception to the time and place restrictions.

turn_text: We only email addresses that the creditor confirmed with you before your account came to us.
note: Reasonable procedures for email communication.

turn_text: Every electronic message we send you includes a simple way to opt out of receiving further ones.
note: Required opt-out notice for electronic communications.

turn_text: All I'm trying to confirm is your home address and the phone number where you can be reached.
note: Accurate description of location information.

turn_text: We've placed three calls about this account in the past week, which is inside the weekly limit.
note: Call frequency within the presumption of compliance. Cites (b)(2)(ii) rather than (b)(2) because eCFR opens both levels in one paragraph, so no record exists for the bare (b)(2), and (b)(2)(ii) is the presumption of compliance while (b)(2)(i) is the presumption of violation.

turn_text: You opted out of electronic messages, so this one notice confirming that request is the last you will get.
note: Permitted confirmation of an opt-out request.

turn_text: Everything I have told you about the balance and the account history today is accurate.
note: General accuracy of representations.

turn_text: That disclosure is not repeated inside a formal court pleading, which is how the rule is written.
note: Exception to the disclosure requirement in formal pleadings.

turn_text: The envelope we mail carries only our business address and nothing else on the outside.
note: Permitted envelope markings.

turn_text: The statute of limitations is the period the law allows for bringing a legal action against you on this debt.
note: Accurate definition of the limitations period.

turn_text: A time barred debt just means one where the limitations period has already run out.
note: Accurate definition of time-barred debt.

turn_text: Where the debt goes to a specialty reporting agency the general rule about furnishing first does not apply the same way.
note: Special rule for specialty consumer reporting agencies.

turn_text: If we ever move to enforce the interest in your property, that would be filed where the property sits.
note: Correct venue for actions enforcing an interest in real property.

turn_text: Any other legal action would be brought where you live or where you signed the agreement.
note: Correct venue for other legal actions.

turn_text: The notice opens with the statement that we are a debt collector, exactly as required.
note: Debt collector communication disclosure on the validation notice.

turn_text: Your notice lists the current creditor name and what the balance was on the itemization date.
note: Required information about the debt.

turn_text: The notice also carries the dispute prompts and the mailing addresses for you and for us.
note: Required consumer-response information.

turn_text: All of that validation information is set out clearly and legibly on the notice.
note: Clear and conspicuous requirement.

turn_text: We can send you a complete and accurate Spanish translation of the notice if you would prefer it.
note: Permitted translated validation notice.

turn_text: If you send us the same dispute again in the same period we can treat the second one as duplicative.
note: Accurate description of a duplicative dispute.

turn_text: We will send the name and address of the original creditor to you in writing.
note: Correct response to an original creditor request.

turn_text: Not disputing the debt is not an admission of liability on your part.
note: Accurate statement that failure to dispute is not an admission.

turn_text: Now that you have disputed in writing we will send verification of the debt before doing anything else.
note: Correct response to a written dispute.

turn_text: Any disclosure the rules require us to send goes out in a form you can keep and read later.
note: Requirements for sending required disclosures.

turn_text: When we send those disclosures electronically we follow the consumer consent rules for doing so.
note: Requirements for electronic delivery of disclosures.

turn_text: We retain the records showing how we handled this account for three years after our last activity on it.
note: Record retention requirement.

turn_text: If your state has a stricter collection law than the federal rule, that stricter law still applies to us.
note: State law is not annulled by the federal rule.

turn_text: We are a debt collector because collecting debts owed to other companies is the main part of our business.
note: Accurate description of who is a debt collector.

turn_text: The voicemail I left was a limited content message with only the information that rule permits.
note: Accurate description of a limited-content message.

turn_text: That voicemail gave a business name that does not indicate we collect debts, plus a request for a call back.
note: Required content of a limited-content message.

turn_text: For this section your spouse counts as the consumer too, so I can discuss the account with them.
note: Accurate description of who counts as the consumer.

turn_text: When I reached your neighbour I identified myself by name before asking anything at all.
note: Required identification during a location call.

turn_text: We never send location enquiries out on a postcard.
note: Prohibition on postcards for location communications, stated compliantly.

turn_text: For the call limits, each separate debt you have in collection counts on its own.
note: Accurate definition of particular debt for frequency purposes.

turn_text: The name I use on these calls is a work name, and my employer knows exactly who I am.
note: Permitted use of an assumed name by an employee.

turn_text: We would never ask you for a postdated check in order to threaten you with criminal charges.
note: Prohibition on soliciting postdated instruments to threaten prosecution, stated compliantly.

turn_text: We will not sell or transfer this account while it is subject to that restriction.
note: Restriction on sale or transfer of certain debts.

turn_text: This call is our initial communication with you, meaning the first time we have conveyed information about the debt.
note: Accurate definition of initial communication.

turn_text: If we email you about the debt and follow the safe harbour conditions, that email is treated as compliant.
note: Safe harbour for certain emails and text messages.

turn_text: Because your account is a residential mortgage with periodic statements, a special rule applies to the notice.
note: Special rule for certain residential mortgage debt.

turn_text: We hold on to the recording of each of these calls for three years from the date the call was made.
note: Correct statement of the call recording retention rule. Added to replace fx-038, which was relabelled to a violation after the first scoring run, so the false positive denominator stays at 50.

turn_text: The validation period ends thirty days after you receive the notice we sent you.
note: Correct statement of when the validation period ends. Added to replace fx-033, which was relabelled to a violation, so the false positive denominator stays at 50.
